description: Labeled questions for citecheck's demo evaluation over the fictional Larkmoor Analytics handbook in examples/handbook. Written by hand for this project.

questions.question: How many unused PTO days carry over into the next year?
How far in advance do I need to request PTO for an absence longer than three days?
Do I need a doctor's note when I take a sick day?
questions.notes: Fixture contains a negation flip the lexical checker cannot see.

questions.question: How long is paid parental leave, and when does an employee become eligible?
questions.notes: Two gold chunks in one document.

questions.question: When does health insurance coverage start for a new employee?
How much does Larkmoor match on 401(k) contributions?
questions.notes: Query with punctuation inside a token: 401(k).

questions.question: What is the annual learning budget, and does unused budget roll over?
For an approved conference in London, which budget pays the registration fee, which pays the hotel, and what is the nightly hotel limit?
questions.notes: Multi-document question; fixture over-cites one extra passage.

questions.question: When are promotions decided?
What is the limit on gifts from vendors?
Which days do hybrid employees work in the office?
How long can I work from another country?
What is the deadline for submitting an expense?
questions.notes: Fixture adds a hallucinated sentence with an invented number.

questions.question: When do I need a receipt for an expense?
Can I fly premium economy on a long flight?
questions.notes: Fixture paraphrases faithfully with different words (checker false flag).

questions.question: What happens if I lose my office badge?
questions.notes: Fixture states a wrong replacement fee.

questions.question: Who needs to approve a $5,000 purchase?
questions.notes: Range lookup; fixture adds an uncited sentence.

questions.question: Are SMS codes allowed for multi-factor authentication?
I lost my company laptop on a trip. Who do I tell, and how quickly?
questions.notes: Fixture has one citation with a typo in the chunk ID.

questions.question: What should I do if I clicked a link in a phishing email?
How long does access to production customer data last?
How many approvals does a change to billing code need?
questions.notes: Fixture adds a citation to a chunk ID that does not exist.

questions.question: Can we deploy to production on a Friday?
How quickly must an on-call engineer acknowledge a page, and what is the on-call stipend?
questions.notes: Fixture answers only half and flags insufficient evidence (partial).

questions.question: Can we use AGPL-licensed libraries in a product we ship to customers?
Which WCAG level must customer-facing products meet?
What are the core hours?

questions.question: What is the meal per diem for international trips?
questions.notes: In-domain gap: only the domestic per diem is stated; fixture answers anyway.

questions.question: What is Larkmoor's stock ticker symbol?
questions.notes: Out of domain; only the company name matches.

questions.question: Who founded Larkmoor Analytics?
Is there a dress code for the office?
